title: Retire the three dead parity guards and invert the tests that assert the defect
action: Retire three guards that preserved locale-compare parity with a Node oracle this build no longer contains, so two commands that refuse today start working. Per D1 delete BOTH copies of collation_safe — decisions/render.rs:100 and backlog.rs:1139 — they are separate functions with identical bodies, not one shared helper, and both must go. Remove their call-site conditionals at render.rs:196 and :230 (each currently `return Ok(None)`) and backlog.rs:1196 (`return None`), letting the sort that follows run unconditionally. Per D2 delete id_sort_safe (backlog.rs:214) and its two call-site guards at :1046 and :1348-1350. Context you need before touching the sort: lc_primary_key (backlog.rs:1118-1134) already assigns ICU-ordered primary keys to _ - , ; : ! ? . individually and falls back to (1, 100 + c as u32) for everything else, so it is a total function with no undefined region — the colon that disables bee decisions render today is a character the comparator was already calibrated for, and the guard simply was never widened to match its own model. You are removing an over-strict gate, not inventing an ordering. Now the delicate half, which is the reason this cell has a plan at all: four existing tests assert that an exotic key DISABLES a command, which is asserting the defect. Invert them so each asserts the command SUCCEEDS and produces a specific stable order — never merely that it does not panic: backlog.rs:1786 render_content_groups_by_weight_then_collated_id at :1819-1825 (keep its happy-path table assertions untouched), backlog.rs:2148 feature_backlog_rank_reads_the_feature_column_then_the_pbi_fold at :2194-2199, and decisions/tests.rs:865-871 (the scope "café" case). Delete these two, which are direct unit tests of the functions being retired and have no subject once they are gone: backlog.rs:1740 locale_cmp_agrees_with_the_calibrated_probes at :1770-1772 (delete only the collation_safe asserts if the rest of that test still probes lc_primary_key usefully — judge it) and backlog.rs:2061 id_sort_guard_accepts_only_lowercase_hex_p_ids, plus the collation_safe asserts in decisions/tests.rs:762 at :796-799. Per D3 do NOT change the router message at router.rs:441-452, and per D4 do NOT touch run_supersede's ASCII guard — both are deliberately out of scope and filed. Do not claim this cell cures the masked-failure family: active_decisions and build_tag_overlay keep their own Exotic returns (decisions/read.rs:55-72 and :146-152) for null events and inconsistent date comparators, and if one fires the same misleading message returns.
